text:
alice-nguyen: Running the Mistral3 quant bakeoff today, AWQ vs GPTQ vs native int8. Hit a weird kernel latching on CUDA 13 when using the TRT-LLM plugin :confused:
ben-ortega: what's the failure mode? hangs, OOM, wrong outputs? :eyes:
alice-nguyen: It stalls during first forward after kv-cache warmup. No GPU OOM, processes alive but no progress. CPU trace shows one thread spinning on kernel launch.
carmen-lee: can you paste the container logs? especially the trtllm stderr and nvdriver dmesg snippet
alice-nguyen: pasted logs below:
```
2026-02-14T15:02:12Z trtllm: loading engine /models/mistral3-awq.engine
2026-02-14T15:02:12Z trtllm: runtime kernel: cuLaunchKernel returned 999
2026-02-14T15:02:12Z trtllm: fallback to cpu path
2026-02-14T15:02:12Z runtime: kv-cache warmup complete
2026-02-14T15:02:12Z trtllm: kernel stuck launching, thread stuck
```
[dmesg excerpt]
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=11234, Graphics Exception: GPC in lossless state
```

dmitri-ivanov: Xid 31 implies a GPU exception; often driver mismatch with tensorRT kernels. Which CUDA/TensorRT combo?
alice-nguyen: CUDA 13.0.2, driver 535.113, TensorRT 8.7.1, trt-llm plugin v0.9. ci image is `redwood/rt:cuda13-trt8.7-v0.9`
ben-ortega: we saw something similar on A100 stack when AWQ used fused kernels that assumed cuBLAS/cuDNN symbol versioning; older drivers tolerated it, newer ones crash with Xid 31. Try forcing plugin to use non-fused path: `TRTLLM_DISABLE_FUSIONS=1`
carmen-lee: also try running with env `TRTLLM_KERNEL_CHECK=1` to print kernel SM/arch selection, might show mismatched PTX path.
alice-nguyen: quick experiment: set DISABLE_FUSIONS=1 and rerun. Result: no Xid, but latency goes up ~1.9x for AWQ path. Accuracy numbers unchanged.
ci-bot: perf-report: model=mistral3, quant=awq, driver=cuda13, trt_plugin=v0.9, disable_fusions=true, p50=48ms, p95=220ms, token_cost=0.62 USU
ben-ortega: okay so fusion kernel is the culprit. But we need performance. Options: downgrade driver to 530.x? or build plugin with PTX targeting sm80 explicitly?
dmitri-ivanov: building plugin for sm86+ might help if H100 vs A100 differences. Also try vLLM path as a fallback - it doesn't use TRT-LLM kernels and may avoid driver kernel launches causing Xid. But vLLM CPU fallback can be slower.
alice-nguyen: ran vLLM path (vllm runtime, cuda13 driver) - stable, perf p50=62ms, p95=260ms for AWQ. Better than disable_fusions but worse than fused TRT path on older driver. Accuracy deltas: AWQ+fused = -0.7% on eval set, AWQ+nofuse = -0.8%, vLLM = -0.75% (all within noise)
carmen-lee: important to capture reproducible test: commit hash, docker digest, driver version, and small eval prompt set. We should add a regression test in CI that runs the fused kernel smoke on 1 GPU and fails if Xid occurs.
ben-ortega: agreed. Action items: 1) alice to capture full repro and docker digest. 2) dmitri to try building trt-llm plugin with explicit arch flags and run on staging. 3) carmen to add a CI smoke that runs fused AWQ on sample prompts (skip on H100 for now).
alice-nguyen: starting capture now. Repro steps in thread: 
```
# repro
docker run --gpus all --rm -e TRTLLM_DISABLE_PROF=0 -e TRTLLM_DISABLE_FUSIONS=0 redwood/rt:cuda13-trt8.7-v0.9 \
  /bin/bash -lc "python3 /bench/run_inference.py --model mistral3-awq --batch 1 --seq 512 --warmup 10"
```
ben-ortega: thanks. if we can't get fused kernels stable on cuda13 across driver versions, we should add a runtime policy: prefer fused when driver >= 535 and plugin built-for-driver, otherwise use vLLM or no-fuse path. That preserves perf for customers on validated stacks.
dmitri-ivanov: I'll try a CI build of plugin with `-gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -gencode arch=compute_90,code=sm_90` and drop a binary in staging, ETA EOD.
carmen-lee: FYI tagging infra for dedicated capacity: we should pin the driver+plugin combination in the image metadata so Dedicated customers don't get broken upgrades.
alice-nguyen: will file issue with logs and attach perf CSV. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ci-bot: created issue #ML-5234: "trt-llm fused kernel Xid31 on CUDA13 - AWQ path" linking this thread
